news.headline: Lions 2026 fifth-round pick Kendrick Law tears ACL in practice
news.description: Lions rookie wide receiver Kendrick Law suffered a torn ACL during Tuesday's OTA practice in a noncontact drill.

news.headline: Alabama WR, return man Cole Adams out for season with injury
news.description: Alabama will be without WR and return man Cole Adams Saturday against No. 14 LSU. The Tide announced Monday that Adams will miss the rest of the season with a lower-body injury that he suffered two weeks ago against Missouri.
